chapterTitle: Chapter 1: A Day at the Beach 🏖️
learningGoals: Count objects in groups accurately up to 20. 🐚
Understand and use positional words like above, below, near, and far. 📍
Solve simple addition problems using visual stories and pictures. ➕
Build observational skills by noticing details in a picture. 👁️
teachingTips: Use shells, pebbles, or buttons to practice grouping and counting at home. 🪨
Ask your child spatial questions like 'What is under the table?' or 'What is far from you?' 🤔
Create simple addition stories using their favorite toys to make math relatable. 🧸
Point out groups of items during grocery shopping and ask your child to count them. 🛒

funActivities.title: Shell Sorting 🐚
funActivities.description: Mix up different sized buttons, coins, or pebbles and ask your child to sort them into groups and count them.

funActivities.title: I Spy Positions 🕵️‍♂️
funActivities.description: Play 'I Spy' using position words, for example: 'I spy something blue under the chair!'

funActivities.title: Beach Towel Math 🏖️
funActivities.description: Place a towel on the floor, put a few toys on it, and ask your child to count them. Add one more and ask 'How many now?'
